connections.title: AI connections
connections.description: Let Codex, Claude Code, and Grok access selected lists. Each connection has its own credential, and changes need confirmation by default.

proposals.title: Review queue
proposals.description: Review the changes and their sources before applying them. Dependent changes are submitted together.

proposals.updated: Proposal updated. Review it, then confirm.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Summarize task changes and materials into suggestions for the review queue. Enabled rules run while the local service is running.
reviews.savedToast: Rule saved. Preview it, then enable it.
reviews.providerExternal: Basic review + external AI organization request
reviews.providerClaude: Basic review + limited Claude Code organization
reviews.keptHint: Organization results stay in the project materials. Candidates go to the review queue.

handoff.title: AI handoff
handoff.description: Freeze the current task and selected context. You accept the result when it comes back.
handoff.saveFirst: Save your task edits before preparing a handoff.
handoff.modeManual: Existing session claims it via MCP
handoff.goalPlaceholder: What should the AI finish, and what constraints apply?
handoff.allowWrite: Allow file edits in an isolated copy
handoff.allowShell: Allow project commands (such as running tests)
handoff.runsDescription: Prepare a handoff from the task menu. Track the run, collect artifacts, and review them here.
handoff.editGoal: Edit the goal and acceptance notes
handoff.manualClaim: In the connected {{provider}} session, ask it to read {{id}} with get_handoff, then call claim_handoff.
handoff.sourcePlaceholder: Absolute path of the local project
handoff.gitHint: Git projects are copied from the current HEAD. Uncommitted work is left out. You can preview the changes when the run finishes.
handoff.inputFilesPlaceholder:
One relative path per line, for example:
notes/requirements.md
reference.txt
handoff.inputFilesHint: Only the listed files are copied into an isolated directory, up to 100 files and 32 MiB in total. Leave this empty to start from an empty directory. Leave Git projects empty.
handoff.proposalsToast: Changes from the result were added to the review queue
handoff.makeProposal: Turn the result changes into a proposal
handoff.completeChildren: When accepting and completing, also complete the remaining subtasks
handoff.verifiedStopped: I verified in the system that this run's process and child processes have stopped
handoff.adjustPermissions: Adjust permissions for the next run
handoff.allowCopyWrite: Allow edits to the isolated copy
handoff.noSession: This run has no registered host session. A retry opens a new session and keeps it linked to this record.
handoff.fixSource: You can correct the source directory and input files above. Unchanged choices keep the previous settings.
handoff.continuePlaceholder: Add notes and start a new run
handoff.binary: Binary artifact. You can download the original file.
